title: Hushfrost Pass - Numbed at the Throat
_note: Option B mood sibling, more Dark. gbc 4-voice band. emotional. Unresolved F Locrian-leaning minor (b2 Gb, b5 Cb=B nat), 66 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars. Lead that gutters: phrases start clean then waver and trail off mid-phrase into rests (faked by chromatic neighbour wobble + long rests). Cold cluster arp (Gb/Cb against F) that refuses to resolve and drops out for whole bars. Faltering bass occasionally a beat late. Heartbeat slowed and thinned — every other bar it skips, the pulse failing. Vesper motif appears then FAILS to land: rising leap C4->F4->Gb4 reaches up, the settle never completes, dissolving into a rest. Last bar leaves an unresolved Gb->C tritone tension voice-leading into bar 1's F.
